sn16.5:1.1: evaṃ me sutaṃ: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā
sn16.5:1.3: atha kho āyasmā mahākassapo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho āyasmantaṃ mahākassapaṃ bhagavā etadavoca:
sn16.5:1.4: jiṇṇosidāni tvaṃ kassapa. garukāni kho te imāni sāṇāni paṃsukūlāni nibbasanāni.
sn16.5:1.5: tasmātiha tvaṃ kassapa, gahapatikāni ceva cīvarāni dhārehi, nimantaṇesu ca bhuñjāhi, mamañca santike viharāhīti.
sn16.5:2.1: ahaṃ kho bhante, dīgharattaṃ āraññako ceva āraññakattassa ca vaṇṇavādī, piṇḍapātiko ceva piṇḍapātikattassa ca vaṇṇavādī, paṃsukūliko ceva paṃsukūlikattassa ca vaṇṇavādī, tecīvariko ceva tecīvarikattassa ca vaṇṇavādī, appiccho ceva appicchatāya ca vaṇṇavādī, santuṭṭho ceva santuṭṭhiyā ca vaṇṇavādī, pavivitto ceva pavivekassa ca vaṇṇavādī, asaṃsaṭṭho ceva asaṃsaggassa ca vaṇṇavādī, āraddhaviriyo ceva vīriyārambhassa ca vaṇṇavādī.
sn16.5:3.1: kimpana tvaṃ kassapa, atthavasaṃ sampassamāno dīgharattaṃ āraññako ceva āraññakattassa ca vaṇṇavādī, (evaṃ peyyālo.) piṇḍapātiko ceva …pe…
sn16.5:4.1: “dve khohaṃ bhante, atthavase sampassamāno dīgharattaṃ āraññako ceva āraññakattassa ca vaṇṇavādī …pe… piṇḍapātiko ceva …pe…
sn16.5:5.1: attanā ca diṭṭhadhammasukhavihāraṃ sampassamāno - pacchimañcajanataṃ anukampamāno
sn16.5:5.3: ye kira te ahesuṃ buddhānubuddhasāvakā, te dīgharattaṃ āraññakā ceva ahesuṃ āraññakattassa ca vaṇṇavādino,
sn16.5:5.11: āraddhaviriyā ceva ahesuṃ viriyārambhassa ca vaṇṇavādinoti.
sn16.5:5.12: te tathattāya paṭipajjissanti. tesaṃ taṃ bhavissati dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāya.”
sn16.5:6.1: ime khohaṃ bhante, dve atthavase sampassamāno dīgharattaṃ āraññako ceva āraññakattassa ca vaṇṇavādī, piṇḍapātiko ceva …pe…
sn16.5:7.2: bahujanahitāya kira tvaṃ kassapa, paṭipanno bahujanasukhāya lokānukampāya atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānaṃ.
sn16.5:7.3: tasmātiha tvaṃ kassapa, sāṇāni ceva paṃsukūlāni dhārehi nibbasanāni, piṇḍāya ca carāhi, araññe ca viharāhīti.
